description: A C# application under central package management that ships an installer. The nuget manager cannot tell a runtime package from a test package, because every PackageVersion carries the same depType. A package in Directory.Packages.props is therefore a fix, and the repository names its test-only packages as chore.
The SDK in global.json, the MSBuild SDKs and the tools in dotnet-tools.json stay chore. A refreshed packages.lock.json changes the assemblies the installer carries, so lock file maintenance is a fix.
The WiX project is not in the nuget manager's default file list. managerFilePatterns is additive.
